posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
I can't help but think that AZ is his own worst nemesis.  His entire story is about causing fights, blaming himself, and spiraling into depression (which he's never really come back from).

I could see several scenarios in which he becomes a villain himself, or where he tries something risky and it spirals out of control.  

1. Currently, he is trapped in the suit when he wants to interact with the outside world.  We've seen several incaps and environments where suit failure leaves him at a disadvantage.  What if someone promised him the ability to walk around without his suit?  Pike industries was where he had his initial accident- they could certainly offer drugs and chemicals to help him regulate.  Or perhaps even a new body to transfer his consciousness into (through the biomimetic plasma vat)?  We've seen that the Operative seems to be around far after you'd expect the Chairman to have been exposed and imprisoned- maybe she cut a deal...  OF course- the trouble with drugs and cloned bodies is that they could have all sorts of side effects.  

2.  Filter has all kinds of high tech available to them, and they have quite a lot of experience in man/machine interfacing (KNYFE has an enhancing suit, Choke appears to be cybernetic).  His equipment getting destroyed is a common theme, so integrating some of the parts into his body could give him more freedom.  for a price.

3. Theres always space-borne viruses and Nanotech.  nanotechnology could help him regulate his temperature at the cellular level, giving him a normal life.  unless it goes haywire.  A nanotech villain could be a lot of fun, especially if it did heat damage as it consumed equipment...

 

right now, AZ's story is at a virtual standstill.  we need a crisis that affects him personally to really see him step up and accept his heroic status.  for his story to pregoress, he needs to make a mistake and then (instead of running or getting depressed) step up and do something to fix it.
